segments.text: And if God ſhould provide ſuch a mercie for us, as to incline the Magiſtrates hearts ſo for to tender our conſciences, as that we might bee protected by them from wrong, injury, oppreſſion and moleſtation, which long we formerly have groaned under by the tyranny and oppreſſion of the Prelaticall Hierarchy, which God through mercy hath made this preſent King and Parliament wonderfull honourable, as an inſtrument in his hand, to throw downe; and we thereby have had ſome breathing time, we ſhall, we hope, look at it as a mercy beyond our expectation, and conceive our ſelves further engaged for ever to bleſſe God for it.
